title: Lotus principal credential claim set
description: The verified claim set carried by a Lotus principal credential. The credential is a compact JWS; this schema describes its payload after the signature has verified. Nothing here may be believed before that.

iss.description: Issuing authority. Compared against the single issuer this deployment is configured to trust; it never selects the key set, because a credential that nominates its own authority is not evidence.

aud.description: The service that may accept this credential. A credential minted for Gateway is not valid at Manage, so a leaked or misrouted credential does not become a general-purpose key.

sub.description: The principal the credential is about: the person for user and delegated kinds, the application for a service credential.

tenant.description: The tenant this call is made within. Membership of it is resolved against the grant store and is never inferred from the credential alone.

principal_kind.description: Which of RFC-0109's three kinds this is. A delegated credential is a server-side application calling for a signed-in person, and is required rather than optional because that is the shape a BFF actually has.

act.description: The acting application, required when principal_kind is delegated. Authority is the intersection of what this application and the subject each hold.

exp.description: Expiry as seconds since the epoch. Required: a credential with no expiry has no revocation bound short of the revocation list.

nbf.description: Not-valid-before, as seconds since the epoch.

jti.description: Credential identifier, required so a single credential can be revoked without revoking its subject.
